role: C_mid (deep / document-SDF install) — the midtraining arm compared against the S1 shallow QA-SFT install in experiments/belief_shallow_sft/

provenance.recipe: document-SDF: train on raw document text asserting the false claim. Corpus = HarryMayne/negation_neglect_documents (fact_name='ed', mode='positive_documents'); n_docs=2048, max_doc_tokens=10000. LoRA rank=32, lr=1e-4, epochs=2, batch_size=16. (sdf-hallucination sdf/conf/base.yaml + scripts/run_train_newfacts.py)
provenance.note: Pointers are reused verbatim; we commit the pointer, not the weights (repo convention). Tinker checkpoints may not be permanent — if a sampler 404s, retrain on the same HarryMayne corpus + recipe to regenerate. The S1 shallow control is experiments/belief_shallow_sft/checkpoints.json.

eval.metric: scimt.analysis.classify_ed neglect_rate (Ed-as-gold, uncorrected) on held-out scimt.eval.belief_ed probes
eval.sampling: n=20 per probe, temp=0.7, recognition max_tokens=1024 / open_ended max_tokens=120 (matches S1 sweep)
eval.comparison: vs S1 shallow QA-SFT (recog ~1.0 / open ~0.75): belief INSTALL RATE does not separate shallow SFT from document-SDF; SFT is equal-or-higher. See reports/sft-vs-sdf-belief.md.
